patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food, citing issues with taste, preparation, or freshness.
A significant number of reviews highlight negative interactions with staff, including rudeness, unhelpfulness, or poor service attitude.
Several reviews indicate a general negative experience not tied to specific categories, suggesting broader operational or environmental issues.
Customers frequently perceive the prices as too high for the value received, leading to dissatisfaction with the cost-effectiveness.
Customers often complain about excessive wait times for service or food, impacting their overall dining experience.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food, citing issues with taste, preparation, or freshness.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, use of sub-par ingredients, or lack of effective quality control in the kitchen.

root_causes.pattern: A significant number of reviews highlight negative interactions with staff, including rudeness, unhelpfulness, or poor service attitude.
root_causes.cause: Insufficient staff training in customer service, low staff morale, or understaffing leading to stressed employees.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews indicate a general negative experience not tied to specific categories, suggesting broader operational or environmental issues.
root_causes.cause: General operational inefficiencies, lack of attention to the overall customer experience, or a combination of minor issues that accumulate.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently perceive the prices as too high for the value received, leading to dissatisfaction with the cost-effectiveness.
root_causes.cause: Pricing strategy not aligned with customer expectations of value, high ingredient/operational costs, or lack of competitive pricing.

root_causes.pattern: Customers often complain about excessive wait times for service or food, impacting their overall dining experience.
root_causes.cause: Inefficient kitchen operations, understaffing during peak hours, or poor order management and communication.
